name: noctua-site-tests
description: Dev-only. The site itself ships no build step and no runtime dependencies; these exist so tests/ can load a page in a real DOM and parse its scripts.

scripts.test: ./tests/run.sh && ./tests/run-api.sh && node tests/dead-code.mjs admin/edit/index.html asset/index.html inspection/index.html index.html assets/index.html hub-core.js noctua-data.js noctua-auth.js noctua-share.js noctua-write.js noctua-account.js inspection-resolver.js card.js eval-pane.js viewer-shell.js scene-core.js
